lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਅੰਧੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਚਪਲੁ ਸਿਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan a(n)dhee pir chapal siaanaa ||
lines.translation: The body-bride is blind, and the groom is clever and wise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਾ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch tat kaa rachan rachaanaa ||
lines.translation: The creation was created of the five elements.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਆਏ ਹਹੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jis vakhar kau tum aae hahu so paaio satigur paasaa he ||6||
lines.translation: That merchandise, for which you have come into the world, is received only from the True Guru. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਕਹੈ ਤੂ ਵਸੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan kahai too vas mai naale ||
lines.translation: The body-bride says, "Please live with me,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pri sukhavaasee baal gupaale ||
lines.translation: O my beloved, peaceful, young lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝੈ ਬਿਨਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਵਚਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tujhai binaa hau kit hee na lekhai vachan dehi chhod na jaasaa he ||7||
lines.translation: Without you, I am of no account. Please give me your word, that you will not leave me". ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਹਉ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir kahiaa hau hukamee ba(n)daa ||
lines.translation: The soul-husband says, "I am the slave of my Commander.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਭਾਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਛੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu bhaaro thaakur jis kaan na chha(n)daa ||
lines.translation: He is my Great Lord and Master, who is fearless and independent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਜਾ ਸਦੇ ਤ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jichar raakhai tichar tum sa(n)g rahanaa jaa sade ta ooth sidhaasaa he ||8||
lines.translation: As long as He wills, I will remain with you. When He summons me, I shall arise and depart." ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਚਨ ਕਹੇ ਧਨ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau pri bachan kahe dhan saache ||
lines.translation: The husband speaks words of Truth to the bride,

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸਮਝੈ ਚੰਚਲਿ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan kachhoo na samajhai cha(n)chal kaache ||
lines.translation: but the bride is restless and inexperienced, and she does not understand anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਓਹੁ ਬਾਤ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: bahur bahur pir hee sa(n)g maagai ohu baat jaanai kar haasaa he ||9||
lines.translation: Again and again, she begs her husband to stay; she thinks that he is just joking when he answers her. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਈ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaee aagiaa pirahu bulaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Order comes, and the husband-soul is called.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਧਨ ਪੁਛੀ ਨ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa dhan puchhee na mataa pakaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He does not consult with his bride, and does not ask her opinion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਓ ਛੂਟਰਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਦੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਥਨ ਮੋਹਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: ooth sidhaaio chhootar maatee dekh naanak mithan mohaasaa he ||10||
lines.translation: He gets up and marches off, and the discarded body-bride mingles with dust. O Nanak, behold the illusion of emotional attachment and hope. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੋਭੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man lobhee sun man mere ||
lines.translation: O greedy mind - listen, O my mind!

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਸਦੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev din raat sadere ||
lines.translation: Serve the True Guru day and night forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਚਿ ਮੂਏ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਗਲਿ ਜਮ ਫਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur pach mooe saakat nigure gal jam phaasaa he ||11||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, the faithless cynics rot away and die. The noose of Death is around the necks of those who have no guru. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh aavai manamukh jaavai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh comes, and the self-willed manmukh goes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh phir phir chotaa khaavai ||
lines.translation: The manmukh suffers beatings again and again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਨਰਕ ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੋਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: jitane narak se manamukh bhogai guramukh lep na maasaa he ||12||
lines.translation: The manmukh endures as many hells as there are; the Gurmukh is not even touched by them. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh soi j har jeeu bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He alone is Gurmukh, who is pleasing to the Dear Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kaun mitaavai j prabh pahiraaiaa ||
lines.translation: Who can destroy anyone who is robed in honor by the Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਆਨੰਦੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਪਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਖਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d kare aana(n)dee jis sirapaau paiaa gal khaasaa he ||13||
lines.translation: The blissful one is forever in bliss; he is dressed in robes of honor. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur poore ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਬਚਨ ਕੇ ਸੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran ke daate bachan ke soore ||
lines.translation: He is the Giver of Sanctuary, the Heroic Warrior who keeps His Word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਨ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਜਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa prabh miliaa sukhadaataa vichhuR na kat hee jaasaa he ||14||
lines.translation: Such is the Lord God, the Giver of peace, whom I have met; He shall never leave me or go anywhere else. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun nidhaan kichh keem na paaee ||
lines.translation: He is the treasure of virtue; His value cannot be estimated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat poor rahio sabh thaaee ||
lines.translation: He is perfectly permeating each and every heart, prevailing everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਉ ਰੇਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran deen dukh bha(n)jan hau ren tere jo daasaa he ||15||1||2||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of the pains of the poor; I am the dust of the feet of Your slaves. ||15||1||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: karai ana(n)d ana(n)dee meraa ||
lines.translation: My Blissful Lord is forever in bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਿਰ ਸਿਰਹਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat pooran sir sirahi niberaa ||
lines.translation: He fills each and every heart, and judges each and everyone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਕੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sir saahaa kai sachaa saahib avar naahee ko doojaa he ||1||
lines.translation: The True Lord and Master is above the heads of all kings; there is none other than Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਖਵੰਤ ਆਨੰਤ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: harakhava(n)t aana(n)t daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: He is joyful, blissful and merciful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਰਬ ਉਜਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pragat rahio prabh sarab ujaalaa ||
lines.translation: God's Light is manifest everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: roop kare kar vekhai vigasai aape hee aap poojaa he ||2||
lines.translation: He creates forms, and gazing upon them, He enjoys them; He Himself worships Himself. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape kudarat kare veechaaraa ||
lines.translation: He contemplates His own creative power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape hee sach kare pasaaraa ||
lines.translation: The True Lord Himself creates the expanse of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਖਿਲਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਭੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aape khel khilaavai din raatee aape sun sun bheejaa he ||3||
lines.translation: He Himself stages the play, day and night; He Himself listens, and hearing, rejoices. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachaa takhat sachee paatisaahee ||
lines.translation: True is His throne, and True is His kingdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach khajeenaa saachaa saahee ||
lines.translation: True is the treasure of the True Banker.
